name: phone-loneliness
description: Detects when a brAIn-mobile phone has been put down (accelerometer steady within ±max_range over window_ms), then asks an LLM for a passive-aggressive English one-liner every utterance_period_ms and pushes it to the device's TTS — until the phone moves again.

default_subscriptions.description: Accelerometer stream from any connected brAIn-mobile phone. Used to decide if the phone is still or in motion.
